column1: # rubric.tsv — the sections of the debtplan warrant set, one per test module, in document order.

column2: The Rows: A File Is Ready When It Waits on Nothing and No Import Name Is Unsettled, and Ready Files Sort First
The Cycle Check: A Wait Graph That Could Block Its Own Cards Is Found and Named
The Reduction: A Wait Another Wait Implies Is Dropped, and the Order Is Unchanged
The Plan: Waits Follow the Import Closure Strictly, a Cycle Is One Unit, and an Unsettled Import Name Holds Back Every File Whose Closure Imports It
The Blockers: An Unsettled Name Blocks Only Where Its Answer Could Change a Wait, and Only Once Along a Chain
The Resolutions: A Declared Meaning for an Ambiguous Name Is Read as One Shape and Everything Else Is Refused by Name
The Ledger: One Shape Is Read and Everything Else Is Refused by Name
The Universe: The Tree's Python Files, Relative and Sorted, With What the Walk Skipped Counted
The Queue: One Writer, Called in This Process, With Its Words Captured and Its Cards Read Back
The Mint: A Queue Kept in Step With a Plan, Direct Waits Only, an Ambiguous Name a Card of Its Own, a Working Card Kept Working, the Lock Always Released
The Command Line: Plan Prints JSON, Mint Syncs the Queue, and Every Refusal Is Exit 2
